text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert v2 - HIGH p99 latency SLO burn detected for /v1/generate (region: us-west-2). Current p99 = 1240ms (SLO 800ms). Trigger: consecutive 3min window above threshold. Pager: @sara (primary).

pagerduty-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1847. PagerDuty page sent to @sara.

sara: acked. I'm looking. grabbing hot keys and recent deploys.

sara: @pranav any recent runtime deploys to us-west-2?

pranav: nope no deploys in the last 12h. We did a kernel/driver tweak in the gpu-pool earlier but that was rolled in yesterday's maintenance window. Not seeing obvious deploy link.

sara: grabbing logs from runtime. attaching tail of inference logs for the affected autoscaler group:
```
2026-03-14T14:07:12Z INF request start id=abc123 seq=1 model=redwood-13b quant=8bit
2026-03-14T14:07:13Z WARN kvcache miss id=abc123 miss_rate=0.87
2026-03-14T14:07:13Z INF step latency=430ms token=195
2026-03-14T14:07:14Z INF step latency=890ms token=196
2026-03-14T14:07:15Z ERR tail_latency=1250ms p99 window=180s
```

sara: seeing high KV cache miss rate + step latency spikes. Could be cache thrash after a scaling event. Any autoscaler flaps?

marta: checking autoscaler history now. There was a short scale-in at 13:58 -> scale-out at 14:03 for the pool (requests drop then surge). Might explain cold caches.

sara: ok that matches. Impact: external customers on Hosted API in us-west-2 and some Dedicated endpoints serving that region. Patching customer impact: some chat sessions timing out, increased 504s. Observability shows error rate up from 0.2% -> 2.1% in 15m.

pagerduty-bot: Reminder: If primary is not resolving in 5m, escalate to rotation.

sara: quick mitigations I want to try: 1) temporarily route traffic for the most impacted route (/v1/generate heavy-small-batch) to us-east-1 fallback model variant; 2) increase pool min replicas in us-west-2 by +2; 3) disable aggressive batching to reduce tail. Doing 1 & 3 now.

sara: routing change applied via router-admin: route set --route "/v1/generate" --region us-west-2 --fallback-region us-east-1 --percent 40

pranav: noted. Also toggling batching config: runtime-config update --pool inference-west --preferred_batch_size 8 -> 4

incident-bot: Action log: route-change and batching toggle executed by sara at 2026-03-14T14:10:30Z.

sara: metrics after 2m: p99 dropped from 1240ms -> 740ms, error rate down to 0.9%. Good signal. Continuing to monitor.

marta: since we had autoscaler activity, I'll pin a temporary scale lock to prevent churn: autoscaler lock --pool inference-west --duration 30m --reason "stabilize kv cache"

ken: pinging in as secondary oncall. I can take over if you want to hand off, @sara.

sara: thanks @ken. I want to stabilize for 15m then hand off. Summary for handoff: cause likely KV cache cold/thrash after scale-in/scale-out. Mitigations applied: fallback routing (40% to us-east-1), reduced batch size, increased min replicas (+2), autoscaler lock for 30m. Current p99 ~720-760ms. No deploys implicated.

ken: got it. I'll monitor dashboards and keep PD escalations on standby. If p99 creeps >900ms again, escalate to infra and consider rolling restart of affected nodes.

pranav: adding note: we should also consider warming prime caches for hot prompts — I can push a short synthetic priming job to the pool to populate KV cache across replicas. Running now (priming job id=prime-20260314-01).

sara: priming running. seeing new log entries indicating cache fills.

sara: handing off to @ken at 14:23. Full context above. If anything changes, page me.

pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-2026-1847: acknowledged by sara. Handoff to ken recorded.

ken: acked. Taking ownership. Immediate next steps: watch p99 & error rate for 30m, let autoscaler lock expire and observe behavior, coordinate with infra if we see kernel-level regressions.

marta: documenting incident in ops-runbook: note about autoscaler flaps causing kvcache thrash and recommended mitigations (fallback routing, batch tuning, priming).

ken: thanks everyone. I'll update the incident ticket & postmortem draft if we keep it as an incident. Closing chat here unless we see regression. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-1847 updated: ownership -> ken. p99 restored under SLO after mitigations.

pagerduty-bot: If metrics re-trigger alert, we will re-page the rotation.
